rules.description: Applicant must be married or in a civil partnership (or divorcing/dissolving)
rules.reason_if_failed: Financial consent orders are only available if you are married or in a civil partnership. If you were not married or in a civil partnership, you'll need different legal advice.

rules.description: Conditional order or decree nisi must have been granted
rules.reason_if_failed: The court cannot approve a consent order before you have your conditional order or decree nisi. Apply for a consent order after you receive this.

rules.description: Divorce or dissolution must be under England and Wales jurisdiction
rules.reason_if_failed: This service is for England and Wales only. Scotland and Northern Ireland have different processes.

rules.description: Draft consent order must be prepared and agreed by both parties
rules.reason_if_failed: You need to prepare a draft consent order before applying. This is usually drafted by a solicitor. If you cannot agree, you'll need to apply for a financial order instead.

rules.description: Both parties must agree to the terms of the consent order
rules.reason_if_failed: Both parties must agree to the financial division. If you cannot agree, you'll need to apply for a financial order and ask the court to decide.

edge_cases.description: Applying after final order or decree absolute has been granted
edge_cases.action: Warn that there may be financial consequences, particularly for pensions. Legal advice strongly recommended. Proceed with caution.

edge_cases.description: Domestic abuse present in the relationship
edge_cases.action: Route to specialist support. Consider whether consent order process is appropriate or if contested financial order with protective measures is needed.

edge_cases.description: Judge considers the proposed agreement unfair
edge_cases.action: Application will be rejected with request for amendments. Parties may need legal advice to revise the consent order.

edge_cases.description: Complex assets such as overseas property, business interests, or trusts
edge_cases.action: May require additional documentation and legal advice. Court may request more information before approval.

edge_cases.description: Agreement does not adequately address children's housing or maintenance needs
edge_cases.action: Court prioritizes children's arrangements. May reject order and request amendments to ensure children's needs are met first.
